Game Overview

In Neon Capsule, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a dazzling neon labyrinth, steering your capsule safely downward through perilous tubes. Dodge deadly spikes with precision and speed as the challenge intensifies. Quick reflexes and sharp focus are your only allies in this electrifying descent. Will you master the glowing depths?
